script: Finding clients is a skill you can learn. It is mostly about consistent, polite outreach. Most beginners stop after a few silent replies. This funnel shows why you should keep going. Many messages lead to a few replies, a few replies lead to a sample, and a sample leads to a client. Where should you look? Start with local businesses that have weak social media. Salons, bakeries, clinics, tuition centres, boutiques and restaurants are good places to start. Next, think of friends, relatives and neighbours who run a small business, or who know someone who does. Former colleagues who now work in companies are useful contacts too. You can also check marketplace job posts that match your skill and budget. And community and professional groups are good places, where people ask for help every day.
